description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating three token copies of Esika's Chariot.
When the Esika's Chariots enter the battlefield, their first abilities trigger, creating 18 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing four Cats, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other artifact using Cogwork Assembler.
